- **Status:** Superseded 2026-11-03 (delivered by card 276: commits 25d50b8 to 0000715; .mob/records/276.json; Decider D182)
- **Shape:** Contract
- **Type:** tooling
- **Repository:** mob-defaults (mob-crosscli)
- **Source:** card 276's pre-ship gate HOLD (.mob/records/276/preship-gate.md) and cycle 4's stop (.mob/records/276/record-in-progress.json, decisions.cycle_4). The live Muse voting seat (session e338c0ee-ba55-4c61-9106-2b2546c9f686, .mob/records/276/muse-trial-seat/evidence.json) scanned "no command source". command_source._read_muse_envelope expects payload.command, but Muse 1.4.14 records tool calls as payload_type "tool_batch.effect.started" with payload.record.tool_name ("read_file", "powershell") and no command text in that record, possibly linked by call_id to another record. Rows may be wrapped in retained_frame children[].record_json, and sub-agents log under subagent/<id>/session.jsonl.
- **Depends on:** Muse's Windows shell sandbox being set up (`muse sandbox windows setup`, an elevated change by the product owner or Dispatch), so that one real shell-command record can be captured. Until then, a shell call fails with "sandbox enforcement unavailable: windows_elevated setup_required" (session 93b23003-d64b-439f-801a-ca8c0ef89e03).
- **Actor:** command_source (locate_muse, the Muse envelope reader, scan_entry with source "muse")
- **Given:** a located, parsable Muse session log from a real seat
- **Observes:** the scan reads tool_batch records, wrapped rows and sub-agent logs. Allowlisted read-only tools (such as read_file) count as other tools. Shell commands are extracted from the record that carries their text and judged by scan_command. A log with only read-only tools scans clean with 0 commands. An unknown tool name, or a shell tool whose command cannot be found, is no-source (window 276-scope-3's adopted condition).
- **Fails with:** a finding naming the session, the record and what is missing
- **Invariants:** missing, unreadable, empty, unparsable and unresolved-root logs stay no-source; the claude and copilot readers are unchanged
- **Enables:** card 276 (Muse Code joins the mob as a trial driver): its Done check 3 clean scan
- **One observable behaviour:** a real Muse seat's log scans clean or names its commands.
